title: 재외공관 수입금 등 직접사용에 관한 법률 시행령 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 재외공관 수입금 등 직접사용에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters necessary to enable the heads of diplomatic missions of the Republic of Korea abroad to directly use their revenues and any unspent balance of operating expenses of their offices within the budgets allocated to the respective diplomatic missions, pursuant to Article 2 of the Act on the Direct Use of Revenues, etc. of Overseas Diplomatic Missions.
